policy: Version-specific primary sources; paraphrases, no copied figures or benchmark claims. Publication status does not imply independent reproduction.

sources.title: The Dragon Hatchling: The Missing Link between the Transformer and Models of the Brain
sources.claim: BDH separates fixed connections from a dynamic synaptic state updated through Hebbian interactions. Its graph formulation and GPU-oriented sequence model give that state a role in inference.
sources.relevance: The shared teaching idea is fixed learned parameters alongside writable context-dependent state.
sources.limits: MemoryForge has no BDH neuron graph, sequence model or reported interpretability/scaling experiment. Its 3×16 label memory is not BDH.

sources.title: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
sources.claim: The paper contrasts additive key–value accumulation with DeltaNet's retrieval-and-correction update, and develops parallel training across sequence length.
sources.relevance: An additive memory can mix conflicting associations; changing the update rule is a research direction prompted by that limitation.
sources.limits: MemoryForge uses class-wise averaging of additive writes, not the delta rule or the paper's language-model training method.

sources.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
sources.claim: Titans optimizes a neural associative-memory objective at test time, with momentum and forgetting, and combines neural memory with attention.
sources.relevance: Temporary adaptation can use learned neural-memory updates as well as a simple outer-product rule.
sources.limits: Titans updates memory-module parameters at test time. MemoryForge performs no gradient update during adaptation; its frozen encoder must not be used to imply that every test-time-learning system freezes all parameters.

sources.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
sources.evidence_type: Published system-level interface; not a complete implementation
sources.claim: BDH-CQ describes demonstration-driven recurrent memory with fixed model parameters, followed by iterative computation in a separate latent workspace.
sources.relevance: Its contextual-memory stage directly connects to the lesson; iterative latent reasoning adds a different role beyond storing associations.
sources.limits: The report leaves exact updates, dimensions and implementation details proprietary. MemoryForge does not implement that workspace or establish ARC reasoning performance; BDH-CQ is not needed to derive the toy's equations.

sources.title: Pathway official BDH baseline implementation
sources.locator: bdh.py: Attention.forward and BDH.forward; README baseline scope
sources.evidence_type: Read-only code inspection; not executed or vendored
sources.claim: The inspected code uses causal attention, ReLU-expanded representations and a language-model readout, unlike the lab's class-mean digit-label memory.
sources.relevance: The official baseline makes the architecture boundary concrete.
sources.limits: This repository is not evidence of a complete BDH-CQ implementation. No Pathway source, weights or research figures are copied into MemoryForge.
